\subsection*{Gaussian Space --- Bobkov --- Walk: Introduction}

\subsection*{Gaussian Space --- Bobkov --- Walk: Results}

\begin{definition}[Absorbed fair walk]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.IsAbsorbedFairWalk}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.IsAbsorbedFairWalk}
\leanok
Let $(\Omega,\mathcal{A})$ be a measurable space, let $\mu$ be a measure on it, let
$(\mathcal{F}_t)_{t\in\mathbb{N}}$ be a filtration, and let $Y_t:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$ be
a sequence, with real parameters $a,b,\tau$. The sequence is an absorbed fair walk if
$Y_0=a$ almost everywhere; each $Y_t$ is measurable with respect to $\mathcal{F}_t$;
almost surely, every $Y_t$ lies in $[a-b,a+b]$ and has the form $a+\tau z$ for some
integer $z$; and for every time $t$ and bounded continuous function
$\varphi:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, the conditional expectation of $\varphi(Y_{t+1})$
given $\mathcal{F}_t$ equals almost everywhere $\varphi(Y_t)$ when $Y_t$ is at either
boundary, and otherwise equals $\bigl(\varphi(Y_t+\tau)+\varphi(Y_t-\tau)\bigr)/2$.
\end{definition}

\begin{theorem}[Submartingale from an absorbed fair walk]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_walk_submartingale}
\label{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_walk_submartingale}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.IsAbsorbedFairWalk, BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile}
For every $\delta>0$, there is a $\tau_0>0$ such that the following holds. Let
$(\Omega,\mathcal F,\mu)$ be a probability space with a filtration $(\mathcal
F_t)_{t\in\mathbb N}$, and let $Y_t:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ be an absorbed fair walk with
midpoint $a$, barrier distance $b$, and step size $\tau$. Suppose $b>0$,
$0<\tau\le\tau_0$, $\delta\le a-b$, $a+b\le1-\delta$, and $b=m\tau$ for some natural
number $m$. Then the process
\[
 t\longmapsto \sqrt{U(Y_t)^2+\tau^2t}
\]
is a submartingale with respect to the filtration, where $U$ is the closed Gaussian
profile.
\end{theorem}
